about: fix/intraday-htf-door (2026-11-28), found by re-asking write-capability w02 live on production: on the runtime lane a source input read inside ANY request is the bar series it names, of the requested bars, and Pine's price means (hl2 / hlc3 / ohlc4 / hlcc4) read inside a request are their arithmetic of the requested bar's fields. Each mutant breaks one rule and must turn its rail red.

mutants.mutant: source-input: a source input read inside a request falls through to the stateful-builtin refusal again (runtime:input-state)
mutants.from: if (dv && dv.type === 'name' && MEMBER_SOURCES.has(dv.name)) return lowerExpr({ ...dv, tok: node.tok }, scope)

mutants.mutant: price-means: hl2 / hlc3 / ohlc4 / hlcc4 inside a request are a name nothing binds again
mutants.from: if (mean && scope.lookup(node.name) === null && !env.has(node.name)) return lowerExpr(mean(node.tok), scope)

mutants.mutant: hl2-arithmetic: hl2 inside a request divides by 3 (a wrong mean must not pass as the written arithmetic)
mutants.from: hl2: (t) => meanBin('/', meanBin('+', meanName('high', t), meanName('low', t), t), meanNum(2, t), t),
mutants.to: hl2: (t) => meanBin('/', meanBin('+', meanName('high', t), meanName('low', t), t), meanNum(3, t), t),

mutants.mutant: own-name: a mean replaces a name the script binds itself (`hl2 = close * 10` read as the price mean)
mutants.from: if (mean && scope.lookup(node.name) === null && !env.has(node.name)) return lowerExpr(mean(node.tok), scope)
mutants.expectRed: a name the script binds itself wins
